svg.title: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree — VP anchor, downward traversal
svg.desc: Two-column schematic: left shows the org_tree CTE with a VP anchor at depth 0 and a recursive step that fans downward through all reports, then the final SELECT. Right shows the downward traversal from VP at the top through direct reports to their reports below.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the anchor member of org_tree do, and why start at a VP?')
sendPrompt('How does the recursive step in org_tree fan downward through all reports?')
sendPrompt('What does the final SELECT return from org_tree, and why is no LIMIT needed?')
sendPrompt('Why is the VP the anchor in org_tree and how is it selected?')
sendPrompt('What is depth 1 in the org_tree traversal?')
sendPrompt('What is depth 2+ in the org_tree and when does the recursion stop?')
